SW.Item.Artifact.BlizzardStaff.zh: 向敌人释放一股由灵魂之力驱动的暴风雪，创造一片温暖惬意的冬日奇境。
SW.Item.Artifact.BlizzardStaff.en: Blasts a soul-powered blizzard at your enemies and creates a cozy winter wonderland.

SW.Item.Artifact.CarapaceOcarina.zh: 这个中空尸壳奏出的乐声可抵御远程攻击。
SW.Item.Artifact.CarapaceOcarina.en: The music of this hollowed husk protects against ranged attacks.

SW.Item.Artifact.ConductiveBracelet.zh: 为攻击注入噼啪作响的电击之力，戴在手腕上也格外醒目！
SW.Item.Artifact.ConductiveBracelet.en: Imbues your attacks with the power of crackling electricity and looks striking on your wrist!

SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedBeacon.zh: 将灵魂转化为原始能量，既可以短暂发射，也可以消耗大量灵魂释放一道威力绝伦的冲击波。
SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedBeacon.en: Turns souls into raw power as you fire it in short bursts or in one long, soul-draining blast of ultimate power.

SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedSeeds.zh: 瞬间生出致命藤蔓，使敌人中毒并受到束缚，而你则能收获成果。
SW.Item.Artifact.CorruptedSeeds.en: Instantly sprout into deadly vines, poisoning and binding your enemies while you reap what youâve sown.

SW.Item.Artifact.CreeperCandle.zh: 看起来是再普通不过的蜡烛，但燃烧的烛芯却传来不祥的嘶嘶声…等等，那是引信！
SW.Item.Artifact.CreeperCandle.en: Just a completely normal candle, apart from that ominous hss coming from the burning wick... Wait, thatâs a fuse!

SW.Item.Artifact.DeathcapMushroom.zh: 勇敢的战士会在战斗前食用，进入狂暴状态，同时提升移动和攻击速度。
SW.Item.Artifact.DeathcapMushroom.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle to enter a berserker state, increasing both movement and attack speed.

SW.Item.Artifact.FightersFife.zh: 长笛的乐声能赋予杰出的战士暴击之力。
SW.Item.Artifact.FightersFife.en: The music of the flute grants critical striking powers to any fighter of note.

SW.Item.Artifact.FireBracelet.zh: 为攻击注入熊熊燃烧的烈焰之力，戴在手腕上也光芒四射！
SW.Item.Artifact.FireBracelet.en: Imbues your attacks with the power of a blazing inferno and looks radiant on your wrist!

SW.Item.Artifact.FireworkQuiver.zh: TNT 的爆炸威力加上箭矢的射速，还能出什么岔子呢？
SW.Item.Artifact.FireworkQuiver.en: The explosive power of the TNT combined with the high velocity movement of an arrow, what could possibly go wrong?

SW.Item.Artifact.FlameQuiver.zh: 用正义的怒火点燃你的箭矢。
SW.Item.Artifact.FlameQuiver.en: Light your arrows with the flame of your righteous rage.

SW.Item.Artifact.FlameSceptre.zh: 手持权杖可充入灵魂，随后会释放灵魂之火焚烧敌人。
SW.Item.Artifact.FlameSceptre.en: Hold the scepter to charge it up with souls, then release soul-powered fire on your enemies.

SW.Item.Artifact.FrostBracelet.zh: 为攻击注入凛冽的暴雪之力，戴在手腕上也十分炫酷！
SW.Item.Artifact.FrostBracelet.en: Imbues your attacks with the power of freezing blizzards and looks really cool on your wrist!

SW.Item.Artifact.FrostQuiver.zh: 这些箭会让敌人因恐惧和寒冷而颤抖。
SW.Item.Artifact.FrostQuiver.en: These arrows will have your enemies quivering from both fear and cold.

SW.Item.Artifact.Grindstone.zh: 用磨刀石磨利武器，让敌人感受利刃的刺痛，造成额外伤害。
SW.Item.Artifact.Grindstone.en: Sharpen your weapons on the grindstone to make enemies feel the sting of your steel and cause extra damage.

SW.Item.Artifact.HasteMushroom.zh: 勇敢的战士会在战斗前食用，提高移动速度，然后冲锋陷阵。
SW.Item.Artifact.HasteMushroom.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, sending them charging into battle with increased movement speed.

SW.Item.Artifact.Honeypot.zh: 用黏糊糊的美味困住敌人，同时让嗡嗡作响的伙伴们加入战斗！胜利从未如此甜蜜。
SW.Item.Artifact.Honeypot.en: A sticky treat to trap your enemies as your buzzing friends join the battle! Victory never tasted so sweet.

SW.Item.Artifact.IronHideLute.zh: 这件精美乐器以神龟药水作为涂层，能让所有跟上你节奏的伙伴们获得抗性加成。
SW.Item.Artifact.IronHideLute.en: A beautiful instrument varnished with Potion of the Turtle Master, granting resistance to all friends who catch your groove.

SW.Item.Artifact.LightningQuiver.zh: 这些箭矢会如天雷般击中敌人。
SW.Item.Artifact.LightningQuiver.en: These arrows will strike your enemies like lightning from the skies.

SW.Item.Artifact.LightningRod.zh: 引导由灵魂之力驱动的闪电，只要握住它，就能把敌人电得晕头转向。
SW.Item.Artifact.LightningRod.en: Channels soul-powered lightning, zapping your enemies silly for as long as you hold it.

SW.Item.Artifact.MaimingMushroom.zh: 勇敢的战士会在战斗前服用，释放狂怒，提升攻击速度。
SW.Item.Artifact.MaimingMushroom.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, unleashing their rage and increasing their attack speed.

SW.Item.Artifact.PicnicBlanket.zh: 真是野餐的好天气！和朋友们分享健康的美食吧。饿着肚子可没法并肩作战。
SW.Item.Artifact.PicnicBlanket.en: Great day for a picnic! Share healthy treats with your friends. Hangry friends make for bad allies in battle.

SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonBracelet.zh: 为攻击注入剧毒之力，戴在手腕上也十分惊艳！
SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonBracelet.en: Imbues your attacks with poisonous power and looks stunning on your wrist!

SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonQuiver.zh: 浸泡了毒液的箭袋，让箭矢在命中后附带额外刺痛。
SW.Item.Artifact.PoisonQuiver.en: A quiver soaked in venom for that extra sting when your arrows bite.

SW.Item.Artifact.Powershaker.zh: 来换个花样！巨力砂槌不仅爽快感爆表，还能震撼敌人！
SW.Item.Artifact.Powershaker.en: Letâs shake things up! The Powershaker is a smashing good time and will blow your enemiesâ minds!

SW.Item.Artifact.RallyingHorn.zh: 这支神秘号角发出的声音能将敌人震飞并造成耳鸣。但可能需要多加练习。
SW.Item.Artifact.RallyingHorn.en: The music from this mystical horn will knock enemies over and leave their ears ringing. You may need some practice.

SW.Item.Artifact.RedstoneMines.zh: 这款最先进的地雷发射器，一次能发射一整排的爆炸性红石地雷。
SW.Item.Artifact.RedstoneMines.en: This state-of-the-craft mine launcher will fire a volley of explosive Redstone mines.

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Conductive.zh: 扔向地面即可在身边释放汹涌电流。电力十足！
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Conductive.en: Throw it on the ground to spread conductive chaos around yourself. Itâs a real power trip!

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Fire.zh: 扔向地面即可在身边点燃熊熊烈火。你将变得炽热难挡！
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Fire.en: Throw it on the ground to spread a fierce fire around yourself. Youâll be too hot to handle!

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Freezing.zh: 扔向地面即可在身边掀起刺骨暴雪。绝对是最冷酷的法器之一！
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Freezing.en: Throw it on the ground to spread a blistering blizzard around yourself. One of the coolest artifacts there is!

SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Poison.zh: 扔向地面即可在身边散布恐怖毒雾。别担心，这种“怪物驱逐剂”绝对环保无公害。
SW.Item.Artifact.Satchel.Poison.en: Throw it on the ground to spread toxic terror around yourself. Donât worry, this mob repellent is completely eco-friendly.

SW.Item.Artifact.SmokeBomb.zh: 末影迷雾烟雾弹能让你借助阴影掩护，悄悄靠近敌人。
SW.Item.Artifact.SmokeBomb.en: The Ender Fog smoke bomb lets you sneak up on enemies, cloaked by shadows.

SW.Item.Artifact.SoulHarvester.zh: 先用收集到的灵魂为其充能，随后引发强大的咒力爆弹。
SW.Item.Artifact.SoulHarvester.en: Charge it up with the souls you have collected before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.

SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfCasting.zh: 将图腾置于地面，即可向盟友散发驭器能量，缩短法器的冷却时间。
SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfCasting.en: Place the totem on the ground to spread artificing energy to your allies, reducing their artifact cooldown time.

SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfRegeneration.zh: 这个木质雕像散发着温暖的气息，就像噼啪作响的营火一样，能治疗所有聚集在它周围的伙伴。
SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfRegeneration.en: This wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire and heals all friends who gather around it.

SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfShielding.zh: 这个纯金图腾会展开一道防护屏障，为身处其中的所有同伴阻挡弹射物。
SW.Item.Artifact.TotemOfShielding.en: This solid gold totem radiates a protective barrier, shielding all inside it from projectiles.

SW.Item.Artifact.WarBanner.zh: 高举战旗，为你和附近所有盟友赋予力量。
SW.Item.Artifact.WarBanner.en: Raise the banner of war and grant strength to you and all nearby allies.

SW.Item.Artifact.WardingChimes.zh: 由轰鸣虫尸壳制成的风铃。发出的乐声能让你的皮肤如甲壳般坚硬。
SW.Item.Artifact.WardingChimes.en: Chimes crafted from humbler husk. Their music turns your skin as thick as carapace.

SW.Item.Artifact.WarriorsDrums.zh: 让鼓声激荡战士之心，使所有暴击造成双倍伤害。
SW.Item.Artifact.WarriorsDrums.en: Let the sound of drums fill your warrior heart with the power to do double damage on all critical hits.

SW.Item.Artifact.WitchesBrew.zh: 女巫的秘密配方，掷向敌人会产生一团弱化迷雾。这里面到底加了什么？
SW.Item.Artifact.WitchesBrew.en: A witch's secret formula to throw at your enemies and spread a cloud of weakening vapor. What do they put in this stuff?
